title: Coherent first-page maps and augmented filtered CE lifts
statement: Coherent first-page maps and augmented filtered CE lifts. For every scheme X [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and bounded-below complex K of abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], simultaneously choose termwise presentations D(X,K) [def-weil-pbc-termwise-hypercohomology-presentation], page maps M for each inverse-image complex map v:f^{-1}K -> L [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and realizations e identifying every positive page with the actual cycle/boundary cokernel [lem-sp-filtered-complex-page-differential]. Under the signed first-page comparisons, M is Sheaf.H.map(v.f q) after cohomologyMap [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. For every f,v there exists a map u of sheaf CE totals satisfying the strict augmentation square. Its explicitly conjugated sections lift b [lem-weil-pbc-ce-total-sections-comparison] preserves all filtration steps, and M acts on cycle representatives exactly as b, in the sense of EtaleCEPageMapOnRepresentatives [lem-weil-pbc-ce-stationary-page-naturality]. This assertion contains no stationary bounds or abutment-step/graded-piece comparison.

proof.text: Obtain simultaneous presentations and quotient realizations with descent of supplied comparisons.
Apply the augmented CE bicomplex comparison to each inverse-image complex map, then totalize with its summand and filtration identities.
Apply quotient-page descent to the supplied bicomplex and total maps, and use classical choice to assemble the existential page maps and their witnesses.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_etaleCE_coherent_first_page_lifts :
    ∃ (D : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})),
        EtaleTermwiseHypercohomology X K)
      (M : ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{uNatural}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
        (L : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
        (v : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K.obj ⟶ L.obj),
        (D X K).sequence ⟶ (D Y L).sequence)
      (e : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})),
        EtaleCEQuotientRealization (D X K)),
      (∀ {X Y : Scheme.{uNatural}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
        (L : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
        (v : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K.obj ⟶ L.obj) (p : ℕ) (q : ℤ),
        ((M f K L v).hom 1).f (q, (p : ℤ)) ≫ ((D Y L).firstPageIso p q).hom =
          ((D X K).firstPageIso p q).hom ≫
            AddCommGrpCat.ofHom ((Sheaf.H.map (v.f q) p).comp
              (cohomologyMap f (K.obj.X q) p))) ∧
      (∀ {X Y : Scheme.{uNatural}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
        (L : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
        (v : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K.obj ⟶ L.obj),
        ∃ u : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (D X K).sheafTotal ⟶ (D Y L).sheafTotal,
          ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map (D X K).aug ≫ u = v ≫ (D Y L).aug ∧
          let b := (D X K).totalSectionsIso.hom ≫ ceSectionsLift f u ≫
            (D Y L).totalSectionsIso.inv
          (∀ q : ℤ, ∃ s : ((D X K).L.step q : CochainComplex AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} ℤ) ⟶
              ((D Y L).L.step q : CochainComplex AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} ℤ),
            s ≫ ((D Y L).L.step q).arrow = ((D X K).L.step q).arrow ≫ b) ∧
          EtaleCEPageMapOnRepresentatives (D X K) (D Y L) (e X K) (e Y L)
            b (M f K L v))
